newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gem, jewellery exports slow down.
newsitem.headline: Indian gem, jewellery exports slow down.

text.p: India's gem and jewellery exports in the first six months of fiscal 1996/97 (April/March) fell $67 million to $2.457 billion from $2.524 billion in the corresponding period in the previous year, exporters said on Wednesday.
"For the first time exports of gem and jewellery have shown a downward trend," said Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council chairman Rashmikant Durlabhji.
Addressing a council meeting, he cited higher interst rates on post-shipment credit as a major reason for the decline in gem and jewellery exports.
It would be difficult to achieve the export target of $6.3 billion set for 1996/97 if problems affecting the gem and jewellery industry were not solved, Durlabhji said.
